cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
for r in range(2,17):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=7).value = '=IF(F{0}=\"Covid Test\",\"X\",\"\")'.format(r)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=7).number_format = ws['F2'].number_format
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
